description: A yellow mancala-style board with small cups of blue, green, and clear glass stones sits on a red bedspread in front of a white pillow. The right hand reaches in from the right and pinches up a few stones from a cup on the right side, then moves leftward over the board and drops them one by one into successive cups, shifting back toward the right to pick up and place more stones; the left hand stays out of view and does not touch anything.
